guarantees.claim: msg_ready_o is the logical AND reduction of all bits of msg_ready_shares.
msg_valid is the logical AND reduction of all bits of msg_valid_shares.

uncertain_points.claim: The assignments use AND reduction to combine msg_ready_shares and msg_valid_shares, but in a (re-)masking context, XOR of shares is expected for correct unmasking. The AND reduction would force the output to 1 only if all shares are 1, which may violate masking requirements.
uncertain_points.cond: When msg_ready_shares and msg_valid_shares are intended to be random masking shares.
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect unmasking could cause a masked signal to be always 0 or expose internal state, potentially leaking secret information and breaking side-channel resistance.
